nodes.summary: Let $N$ be the number of situations. For a natural number $i$, the label the generator moves to after the clause of situation $i$ is the end-of-time-step label if $i = 0$. Otherwise it is the first label of the clause routine for situation $i - 1$ if $i - 1 < N$, and the end-of-time-step label again if $i - 1 \ge N$.
nodes.title: Label after a situation clause in the transition-family generator

nodes.summary: Let $N$ be the number of situations and $m$ the number of literals per clause, let $i < N$ be a situation and $j$ a natural number. After the routine for literal $j$ of the clause of situation $i$, the generator moves to the label that emits the leading gap of that clause if $j = 0$. Otherwise it moves to the first label of the routine for literal $j - 1$ if $j - 1 < m$, and to the halting label if $j - 1 \ge m$.
nodes.title: Label after a literal routine in the transition-family generator

nodes.summary: Let $L$ be a layout with label/state block size $A$, $K$ stacks and $g$ symbol codes, let $T$, $H$, $t$ be natural numbers, and write $W = A + KHg$ for the number of variables per time step and $V = (T + 1)W$ for the total number of variables. Counter values $F$ of the generator are at rest at time $t$ when the scratch counters $\mathrm{Q}$, $\mathrm{Ka}$, $\mathrm{tmp}$, $\mathrm{md}$, $\mathrm{c1}$, $\mathrm{c2}$…

nodes.summary: Let $L$ be a layout with $K$ stacks and window depth $d$, let $la$, $na$, $wa$ be the tables and $T$, $H$, $t$, $i$, $j$ natural numbers. Then the gap encoding of $\ell$ from slot $m$ to $V$ is $m' - m$ copies of the absent-slot block $01$ followed by the gap encoding of $\ell$ from slot $m'$ to $V$.

Theory of Computation

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
